jobs.title: Product Manager II, Personalisation
jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

We are looking for a Product Manager II to help shape and scale the personalisation platform that powers relevant experiences for travellers across the customer journey.

In this role, you will focus on one of personalization’s most important challenges: helping the business make useful, timely decisions when we know little or nothing about a traveller. You will lead platform product for experiences serving cold-start, new, and anonymous travellers—using context, intent, behavioural signals, experimentation, and machine-learning capabilities to create relevance from the first interaction.

You will partner closely with engineering, data science, design, analytics, marketing, and customer-facing product teams to turn platform capabilities into measurable traveller and business outcomes. This is a hands-on product role for someone who can move between customer problems, technical trade-offs, and delivery details.

In this role, you will:

- Define and communicate the product priorities and roadmap for personalisation capabilities serving cold-start, new, and anonymous travelers
- Translate traveller and business needs into clear platform requirements, product narratives, success measures, and prioritised backlogs
- Partner with engineering and data science on contextual personalisation, identity resolution, feature generation, model serving, and decisioning
- Collaborate with product teams to make shared personalisation capabilities easy to adopt, test, understand, and measure
- Lead discovery and experimentation, including hypothesis development, test design, rollout planning, and interpretation of results
- Make thoughtful trade-offs across traveller value, business objectives, privacy, fairness, explainability, operational complexity, latency, and platform scalability

Minimum qualifications:

- 2+ years of experience shipping ML products or platform capabilities in a product management role
- Strong product judgment and can frame ambiguous problems, identify high-value opportunities, and make pragmatic decisions
- You are comfortable working with technical teams on application programming interfaces, data flows, event instrumentation, model inputs and outputs, experimentation systems, or other platform concepts
- Experience defining measurable outcomes and using quantitative and qualitative evidence to guide product decisions
- You are customer-centred and curious about how travelers discover, compare, and choose travel products
- You communicate clearly and can influence partners across engineering, data science, design, analytics, and business teams

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with cold-start, new-user, anonymous-user, or session-based personalisation
- You have built or scaled shared platforms used by multiple product teams
- Familiarity with recommendation systems, ranking, contextual bandits, embeddings, feature stores, model serving, identity graphs, or real-time decisioning
- You understand experimentation methodology, causal measurement, online metrics, and guardrail metrics
- Experience with privacy, consent, data governance, or responsible artificial intelligence considerations in personalisation products
- You have worked in travel, commerce, marketplaces, search, media, or another domain where relevance and intent are central to the customer experience

How success will be measured
In your first 12–18 months, success may include:

- Establishing a clear, aligned roadmap for improving personalisation for cold-start, new, and anonymous travelers
- Increasing the coverage and quality of relevant personalised experiences where historical traveler data is limited or unavailable
- Improving traveler and business outcomes through robust experimentation and measurement
- Strengthening adoption of shared personalisation capabilities by partner product teams
- Improving visibility into platform performance, model quality, latency, data health, and key guardrails
- Building trusted operating partnerships across product, engineering, data science, design, analytics, and business stakeholders

Introduction to the Team:
Expedia Group powers travel for everyone, everywhere. As AI becomes core to how travelers plan, book, and manage their trips, it is also changing how we build for them — and merchandising is where that change is furthest along.
The Merchandising Platform team owns the commercial layer of the traveler experience across every Expedia Group brand: price display, product badging, price insights, the algorithms that identify and rank collections, and the merchandising pages and services that power them. Today, brand teams operate this platform manually — designing individual experiments, configuring each change, and waiting weeks between an idea and a result. We are building the agentic systems that change that: autonomous agents that generate hypotheses, assemble experiences from configurable components, run experiments continuously within brand-defined guardrails, and roll out winners — with brand teams acting as strategists and governors rather than operators.

In this role, you will be a hands-on AI builder PM at the centre of that shift. You will prototype and ship multi-agent systems that automate the merchandising experiment lifecycle end to end, define the trust and governance patterns that let agents act safely on live traveler experiences, and lead the most promising capabilities from experiment to production at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands — and set the pattern for how autonomous optimisation expands across the rest of the traveler journey.

In this Role, you will:
- Own the product direction for autonomous merchandising optimisation — from agent-assisted experiment setup today to agents that generate, launch, evaluate, and roll out tests continuously within brand-defined success metrics, guardrails, and policies.
- Rapidly prototype agentic flows hands-on: orchestration across specialised sub-agents, tool/function calling against internal platform APIs, prompt and context design, agent memory, and evaluation harnesses — proving value and feasibility before committing engineering investment.
- Take successful prototypes to production with engineering, data science, and design — including human review gates, guardrail breach detection, automated rollback, audit trails, and attribution so every agent action is measurable and reversible.
- Define the trust architecture for agents acting on live experiences: preview/approve/undo flows, escalation triggers, explainability, and override tracking — patterns designed to be adopted by teams across Expedia Group as autonomous optimisation expands to new surfaces.
- Drive measurable outcomes: compress experiment cycle time from months to days, multiply experiment throughput per surface, and demonstrate conversion and revenue lift from agent-optimised merchandising — without degrading traveler trust or experience quality.
- Partner closely with experimentation, content and configuration platforms, GenAI platform, and brand product teams across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo to make agent capabilities work end to end across the organisation.
- Evaluate emerging capabilities from frontier labs and internal platforms — tool use, multi-agent orchestration, agent memory, evaluation techniques — and translate them into concrete product concepts and working demos.
- Lead the organisational shift alongside the technical one: build brand teams' trust in agent-operated optimisation, define how they set strategy and guardrails rather than individual tests, and share playbooks so agentic operation becomes how merchandising works across Expedia Group.

Minimum Qualifications:
- 10+ years of product management experience building consumer or platform products, including meaningful work with AI, ML, or technically complex systems.
- Strong technical depth and experience partnering with engineering and DS/ML teams; comfortable discussing agent architectures, system design, data flows, tradeoffs, and constraints.
- Hands-on ability to prototype: capable of using APIs/SDKs from major LLM providers and writing simple code (e.g., Python or TypeScript/JavaScript) to stitch together prompts, tools, and agent workflows.
- Proven track record of taking 0→1 product ideas from concept through prototype to launched features, with clear impact on customer and business outcomes.
- Deep experience with experimentation and measurement: A/B testing at scale, success metrics and guardrail definition, instrumentation, and using experiment data to drive iteration — this role automates the experiment lifecycle itself, so fluency here is essential.

- Own the go-forward vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for User Keychain, Expedia Group's customer identity graph, setting the direction for how the company resolves travelers across authenticated and unauthenticated (anonymous) states.

- Audit the existing identity resolution logic and related customer data products within CDP against industry best practices in identity graphs and identity resolution, identifying where we lag, quantifying the gap, and driving the roadmap to close it.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Product Manager III, Intent Understanding & Refinement

Introduction to the Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

Make an impact!
We are looking for a Product Manager III to lead intent understanding and refinement across Expedia Group’s Search and Recommendations experiences.

Travelers often express their needs indirectly: a destination may imply a trip purpose, a collection of words may signal a preference, and an evolving session may reveal intent that was not present in the initial query. This role will help our products understand those signals, refine them into useful traveler context, and translate that understanding into better search and recommendation experiences.

You will define the product strategy, operating model, and roadmap for capabilities that connect traveler intent to relevant results, recommendations, and next-best experiences. You will work across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Research, and business stakeholders to make intent understanding a consistent, measurable capability across the shopping journey.

In this role, you will:
- Establish a clear framework for representing traveler intent, including explicit queries, inferred preferences, trip context, constraints, and changes in intent throughout a session.
- Identify opportunities to improve how intent is captured, interpreted, disambiguated, refined, and passed to downstream experiences.
- Translate ambiguous traveler problems into crisp product requirements, measurable outcomes, and sequenced roadmaps.
- Partner with Data Science and Machine Learning teams on model objectives, feature priorities, evaluation frameworks, feedback loops, and responsible use of personalization signals.
- Work with Engineering and platform teams to define scalable interfaces, data contracts, instrumentation, and self-service capabilities that can support multiple brands, markets, and traveler journeys.
- Own and identify opportunities to improve filters categories/labels/models.
- Balance traveler value, business impact, technical feasibility, operational complexity, and trust when making prioritization decisions.
- Develop a shared taxonomy and language for intent signals and filters so that teams can align on definitions, ownership, quality, and measurement.
- Establish success metrics and guardrails, such as relevance, engagement, progression, conversion, satisfaction, latency, coverage, and fairness.
- Use qualitative and quantitative research, experimentation, behavioral data, and operational feedback to identify gaps and validate solutions.
- Create alignment across a complex stakeholder environment and communicate product direction clearly to senior leaders and delivery teams.
- Help shape the longer-term evolution of Search and Recommendations into more adaptive, context-aware, and traveler-centered experiences.

Experience and Qualifications

Minimum qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in a related field; or equivalent related professional experience
- 5 or more years of product management experience, including ownership of a platform or capability that other teams built on top of
- Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption
- Data fluency, including proficiency with experimentation tooling and the data analysis used to design and evaluate tests
- Experience with machine learning backed products such as ranking or recommendation systems

Preferred qualifications
- Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools or workflows, and with applying machine learning concepts to real world products
- Experience with configurable or low-code platforms where internal teams are your customer alongside the traveler
- Experience trading organic relevance against paid or promoted placement, or a comparable commercial tension

Location expectations
This role is based in Seattle, Washington only.

Senior Product Manager, Traveler Servicing Experience

This role sits within Expedia Group's Traveler & Partner Service Platform (TPSP) Product & Technology group, which builds the product capabilities and experiences that power world-class customer service for travelers and partners. We are looking for a product leader who is passionate about applying AI to solve real problems for travelers when a trip doesn't go as planned, and who has a vision for resolving issues quickly, accurately, and with empathy across conversational AI, web automation, and human agents. This role will join a team that focuses on the end-to-end resolution experience for travelers who need help with issues that arise before, during, or after their trip from booking changes and cancellations to payment issues and day-of-trip disruptions.

As a Senior Product Manager at Expedia, you will define and orchestrate the AI-powered resolution experiences, pairing emerging technology with a deep understanding of traveler needs to reduce the effort it takes to get an issue resolved. You'll build the roadmap for expanding what AI can resolve end-to-end, mentor and influence cross-functional teams, and drive a data-informed, customer-centric product strategy that raises the bar for what "good resolution" looks like.

In this role you will:
- Adopt an AI-First, Customer-First Mindset: Your approach to product development will be rooted in understanding what a traveler needs when something goes wrong. You'll use AI/ML, automation, and general product sense to transform resolution of issues to better meet traveler needs.
- Own a Roadmap: You will define and defend a strategic roadmap that expands the range of trip issues travelers can resolve without waiting for a human agent, improving first-contact resolution and reducing handling time while holding the line on resolution quality and traveler trust.
- Strategic Partnership and Collaboration: You will work closely with the AI Platform team and cross-functional experience, engineering, and data teams to integrate AI capabilities and unify the resolution experience across channels — Help Center, chat, and voice.
- Stakeholder Engagement: You will work with internal stakeholders (customer service operations, engineering, other product managers) and, where relevant, technology partners to identify short-term wins and long-term investments that lead to accurate, complete, and successful resolution experiences.
- Focus on Business Growth: Your work in resolving traveler issues quickly and accurately will directly reduce customer effort at the moments that matter most in a trip, building trust and loyalty

Experience and Qualifications:
- You have a Bachelor's or Master's or equivalent related professional experience, 8+ years for Bachelor's, 6+ years for Master's.
- You own creation of a comprehensive vision and defensible strategic product roadmap that maps target outcomes and KPIs (e.g., resolution rate, handling time, contact deflection) to delivery milestones.
- You have set product metrics to align with the product vision and are accountable for individual and team performance; able to tell data-driven stories that influence product decision-making and prioritization.
- You are skilled in storytelling, persuasion, negotiation, conflict resolution and driving organizational alignment and strategic product leadership through communication; able to convincingly communicate & defend narrative to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.
- You ensure adoption and value delivery through collaboration with internal teams (e.g., Operations, Traveler Experiences, B2B as relevant); develop go-to-market and/or change strategies informed by a compelling value proposition for end users.
- You have identified and delivered on opportunities to apply AI/ML — including generative AI and agentic workflows — to improve resolution outcomes, and you know where automation should defer to a human.
- You have participated in engineering and architecture design and review processes to enable the long-term product vision and ensure solutions that limit future tech debt.
- You have taken ownership of managing complex stakeholder landscapes, balancing diverse interests to drive successful product outcomes on complex, cross-functional teams.
- You have a strong UX sensibility and attention to detail, especially in high-stress, in-trip moments where clarity and trust matter most.
